note: San Isabel NF (San Carlos RD) campground in the Lake Isabel Recreation Area in the Wet Mountains, ~8,600 ft: from I-25 exit 74 take CO-165 west 18 mi to the south entrance, then 1/2 mi. A small RV campground on the wooded slope above Lake Isabel's south shore, in aspen and ponderosa; non-motorized boating and fishing on the lake, Cisneros, St. Charles and Snowslide trails nearby. --Claude
